nations.name: Coushatta Tribe of Louisiana
nations.lands: Southwest Louisiana; the Tribe describes a community centered in Allen Parish

facts.text: The Tribe dates the creation of Coushatta Indians of Allen Parish, Inc. to 1965, describing community organizing to regain federal recognition.
facts.evidence: community members organized Coushatta Indians of Allen Parish, Inc.

facts.text: The Tribe describes a five-member elected council: four council members and a chairman.
facts.evidence: five members: four council members and the chairman.

facts.text: The Tribe dates its first Tribal Council elections to 1985 and describes staggered four-year terms.
facts.evidence: first tribal council elections were held in 1985

facts.text: The Tribe identifies Koasati as a living language spoken by members in Louisiana and by members of the separate Alabama-Coushatta Tribe in Texas.
facts.evidence: Koasati is a living language spoken by members
